dataset.note: Base records are guaranteed unique on (given_name, family_name, date_of_birth, gender). Every duplicate in this dataset is labeled in the ground truth. No unlabeled duplicates exist.

EXACT_DUPLICATE.description: Identical name, DOB, gender, GPS. Different UUID and cycle. Simulates cross-cycle re-registration.
EXACT_DUPLICATE.what_catches_it: Any basic matching on name+DOB should detect these.

PHONETIC_VARIATION.what_catches_it: Soundex or Double Metaphone phonetic encoding.

SPELLING_ERROR.description: Typos: character swaps (Ibrahmi->Ibrahim), dropped/doubled letters, similar-char substitution.
SPELLING_ERROR.what_catches_it: Jaro-Winkler or Levenshtein with appropriate threshold.

NAME_ABBREVIATION.what_catches_it: Prefix matching or substring containment check.

NAME_ORDER_SWAP.description: Given/family name reversed: 'Mahamat Deby' registered as 'Deby Mahamat'.
NAME_ORDER_SWAP.what_catches_it: Cross-field comparison (given1 vs family2 and vice versa).

DOB_VARIATION.description: DOB transcription errors: off-by-one day/month, day-month swap, year +/-1.
DOB_VARIATION.what_catches_it: DOB fuzzy matching with tolerance window.

GPS_NEARBY.description: Same name/DOB, GPS shifted 20-150 meters. Different GPS reading at same location.

COMBINED_NOISE.description: Multiple variations: phonetic + spelling + DOB + GPS + missing phone + cross-cycle.
COMBINED_NOISE.what_catches_it: Multi-attribute weighted scoring pipeline. Tests the full system.

CROSS_BOUNDARY.description: Same person registered in a different boundary/settlement. GPS won't help.
CROSS_BOUNDARY.what_catches_it: Name+DOB matching across boundaries. Cannot rely on GPS proximity.

metrics: Precision: Of pairs flagged as duplicates, what % are actual duplicates?
Recall: Of all actual duplicate pairs, what % were detected?
F1 Score: Harmonic mean of precision and recall
usage: 1. Load dedup_test_records.csv into your dedup pipeline
2. Run matching algorithm to produce candidate pairs with scores
4. Calculate precision, recall, F1 per type and overall
5. Tune scoring weights and thresholds to improve F1
